name: RIT - HubSpot Adhoc → Xero Invoice Create

nodes.name: Build Xero Bill Line Items Payload
nodes.notes: Builds bill lines from each asset's purchase price, matched on asset number.

parameters.query:
SELECT input2.*, input1.InvoiceID AS InvoiceID
FROM input2
CROSS JOIN input1

nodes.name: Combine Bill ID And Line Items
nodes.notes: Joins the new bill's ID with the built bill lines.

nodes.name: Update Xero Bill With Line Items
nodes.notes: Posts the bill lines in one call. Failures go to Normalize Error.

nodes.name: Create Xero Bill
nodes.notes: Creates a DRAFT bill (ACCPAY) with no lines. Lines are added later.

nodes.name: Save Execution Data
nodes.notes: Saves the HubSpot invoice ID against the execution so it is searchable.

nodes.name: Get Line Item Xero Asset ID
Loop Over Assets For Registration
nodes.notes: Runs once per line item to register its Xero fixed asset.

nodes.name: Update Xero Asset Status to Registered
nodes.notes: Moves the Xero fixed asset from Draft to Registered.

parameters.url: =https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{{ $('Attach Invoice ID and State to Line Items').item.json.InvoiceID }}

nodes.name: Update Xero Invoice With Line Items
nodes.notes: One call after the loop finishes, sending every line item at once.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  input2.*,
  input1.InvoiceID,
  input3.body.state AS state
FROM input2, input1, input3

nodes.name: Attach Invoice ID and State to Line Items
Resolve Rental Account by State
nodes.notes: Picks the Xero rental income account from the line item's state. Falls back to WA5000.

nodes.name: Get Invoice Details
nodes.notes: Fetches the HubSpot invoice. Output fans out to three parallel branches: contact, line items, and the final merge.

nodes.name: Save Xero Invoice ID To HubSpot
nodes.notes: Writes the new Xero InvoiceID to xero_invoice_id on the HubSpot invoice.

nodes.name: Create Xero Invoice
nodes.notes: Creates a DRAFT customer invoice with no lines. Lines are added by Update Xero Invoice With Line Items.

nodes.name: Get Invoice With Line Item Associations
nodes.notes: Re-fetches the invoice with its line item associations, to list the line items.

nodes.name: Receive Ad Hoc Invoice Webhook
nodes.notes: Called by a HubSpot workflow when an ad hoc invoice is created. One invoice per call. No auth header is set - see delivery notes.

parameters.query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT TOP 1 input1.properties.xero_customer_id.[value] FROM input1)
    ) AS xeroContactId,
    input2.properties.hs_purchase_order_number AS purchaseOrderNumber,
    input2.properties.hubspot_owner_id AS ownerId,
    input2.properties.hs_createdate AS createDate,
    input2.properties.hs_number AS invoiceNumber,
    input2.properties.hs_due_date AS dueDate,
    input2.id AS invoiceId,
    input2.properties.reference AS reference
FROM input2

nodes.name: Append Xero Contact ID
nodes.notes: Combines the Xero contact ID with the invoice fields used by Create Xero Invoice and Create Xero Bill.

nodes.name: Get Invoice With Company Association
nodes.notes: Re-fetches the invoice with its contact association, to find the contact ID.
